name: Tolaria
description: Manages Markdown knowledge bases as Git-backed vaults in a desktop app, and lets coding agents search, read and edit notes through a built-in MCP server or an in-app agent panel.

skills.name: Vault MCP Server
skills.description: Lets external agents search and read vault content, create notes, and update or append to notes, with an optional modification-time guard.

skills.name: Coding Agent Panel
skills.description: Streams local CLI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode inside the app, in Vault Safe or Power User mode.

skills.name: Git-Backed Vaults
skills.description: Treats every vault as a Git repository, so AI-made edits show up as diffs with full history, rollback and any Git remote.
